pages.text: Six skill trees (Pufferfish's Skills), ~75 earnable points from FTB Quests. Open with $(bold)K$(). Respec: 5 XP levels per point.$(br2)$(bold)Trees:$() Warfare (melee), Marksman (ranged), Sorcery (spells), Fortitude (defense), Gathering (resources), Engineering (automation).$(br2)$(bold)Budget:$() 240 total points to max all trees but only ~75 earnable. You will specialize. Each tree has 8-node trunk, 2 exclusive branches, and 1 capstone.
